variants.name: bid_race_tripoint_wins
variants.purpose: Engine Debt 25k, score under 720: bid_race, Tripoint wins, the Tripoint response and Salesforce post

variants.name: bid_race_amone_wins
variants.purpose: AmOne outbids Tripoint's formula price: winner_branch amone

variants.name: bid_race_no_winner
variants.purpose: Tripoint declines and AmOne fails: the Engine fallback

variants.name: bid_race_no_winner_engine_failed
variants.purpose: no winner and the Engine proxy refuses: engine_ok_branch failed

variants.name: bid_race_partner_outages
variants.purpose: both partners unavailable

variants.name: high_score_engine_offers
variants.purpose: a score of 720 or more: the Engine first, offers found, check_offers exit

variants.name: high_score_engine_no_offers
variants.purpose: a high score and no Engine offers: check_offers pass, then bid_race

variants.name: under_10000
variants.purpose: Engine Debt under 10k: estimated_debt_check else, the direct Engine call

variants.name: under_10000_engine_failed
variants.purpose: under 10k and the direct Engine call fails

variants.name: invalid_state
variants.purpose: a state in the constants list: state_condition_check else, the invalid state fallback. MN is off the snapshot's invented Achieve states too, so achieve_invalid_state turns the lead away as state_not_allowed (#3138)

variants.name: invalid_state_engine_failed
variants.purpose: the invalid state fallback when Engine fails

variants.name: no_trades_scout_estimate
variants.purpose: no trades on the credit report: Eligibility Scout's estimate becomes the debt

variants.name: no_trades_no_estimate
variants.purpose: no trades and no estimate: eligibility_success else, the debt missing fallback

variants.name: no_trades_no_estimate_engine_failed
variants.purpose: the debt missing fallback when Engine fails

variants.name: engine_debt_zero
variants.purpose: Engine Debt zero with little Salesforce debt: a real zero

variants.name: engine_debt_zero_scout
variants.purpose: Engine Debt zero hiding real Salesforce debt: Scout is asked

variants.name: bes_overwrite
variants.purpose: Salesforce overwrites BES

variants.name: credit_freeze
variants.purpose: a frozen credit file

variants.name: equifax_outage
variants.purpose: Equifax unavailable: equifax_debt else

variants.name: parameters_debt_present
variants.purpose: ADV, BES and LEG all positive with a debt: adv_bes_leg_screening parameter_success, debt_present, the 20k response

variants.name: parameters_no_debt_adv
variants.purpose: parameters positive, no debt anywhere: no_debt_but_adv, the fallback ADV response

variants.name: parameters_no_debt_no_adv
variants.purpose: parameters positive, no debt, ADV zero: debt_screening else, the debt not present fallback

variants.name: parameters_no_debt_engine_failed
variants.purpose: the debt not present fallback when Engine fails

variants.name: achieve_rejects
variants.purpose: a Tripoint win with Achieve rejecting the evaluation: the lead passes the Achieve screen as the snapshot has it (invented limits, #3138) and its generated phone is one Achieve takes, so the request is sent and the rejection recorded

variants.name: achieve_screen_turns_away
variants.purpose: the same Tripoint win from a lead asking for half its income: over the snapshot's loan to income ceiling, so the Achieve screen turns it away as loan_to_income_too_high and nothing is sent to Achieve (#3138)

variants.name: trades_with_inquiries
variants.purpose: a Tripoint win whose report carries credit inquiries: the inquiry post sends them, through the Pipedream relay today and the credit-inquiries Apex call after the #1680 port

variants.name: salesforce_inquiry_post_fails
variants.purpose: the inquiry post fails on a report with inquiries: today the Pipedream inquiry relay inside parallel_1, which fails the run; once the relay port moves it (#1680 phase 7), the credit-inquiries Apex call after the outcome write. Drop the pipedream stub when the relays are retired

variants.name: achieve_starts_7500ms_after_answer
variants.purpose: a Tripoint win whose Salesforce write through the Pipedream outcome relay (tripoint_sf_post) answers 7.5 s after the lead is answered, so achieve_tripoint_win starts with 4.5 s of the 12 s window left: exactly the 500 ms margin plus the 4 s floor (#3128), so it still sends, with a 4 s wait. The lead passes the Achieve screen as the snapshot has it (#3138), so the window alone decides

variants.name: achieve_starts_7501ms_after_answer
variants.purpose: the same Tripoint win with the outcome relay write answering 1 ms later, so achieve_tripoint_win starts 7.501 s after the answer, under the margin plus the floor, and skips the lead as answer_window_spent without sending it (#3128)

variants.name: achieve_starts_after_a_timed_out_relay_attempt
variants.purpose: a Tripoint win whose outcome relay write (tripoint_sf_post) gets no answer to its first attempt: the step's own 3,750 ms deadline ends it, the engine waits its 500 ms backoff and the retry is answered, all on the replay's time, so achieve_tripoint_win starts 4.25 s after the answer and sends with what is left of the window, a shortened wait (#3138)

variants.name: achieve_skips_after_two_timed_out_relay_attempts
variants.purpose: the same write with its first two attempts unanswered: two 3,750 ms deadlines and the 500 ms and 1 s backoffs put the third attempt's answer 9 s after the lead's, so achieve_tripoint_win skips the lead as answer_window_spent (#3138)

variants.name: salesforce_collections_post_fails
variants.purpose: a Tripoint win whose credit-collections Apex call fails: the collections slot of parallel_1 (#2832, live since version 177) is marked on_failure continue, so the lead is still answered and the walk goes on past the block, the failure left for finalize to raise as a degraded run
